pizza_photo.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square food card image for a fictional food community and delivery demo
Primary request: appetizing margherita pizza with fresh basil on a plate.
Scene/backdrop: muted terracotta table and a simple uncluttered warm cream background.
Subject: one whole margherita pizza with bubbly charred crust, melted mozzarella, rich tomato sauce and fresh green basil, on an ivory ceramic plate.
Style/medium: high-quality editorial food photography, realistic natural textures.
Composition/framing: square 1:1, three-quarter overhead view, entire pizza and complete plate inside frame with comfortable margins.
Lighting/mood: beautiful natural window daylight, warm inviting appetizing mood.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no people, no hands, no actual restaurant brands.

pizza_pixel.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square food card image for a fictional food community and delivery demo
Primary request: crisp pixel art of a margherita pizza with basil on a plate.
Scene/backdrop: playful lilac tabletop with a simple teal background.
